limitations: Ancillary targeted follow-up. Positive source rows and offsets are descriptive. The X-ray r90 is approximate; PS1 and WISE coordinates remain at catalog epoch. Empty cones do not give image-based limiting magnitudes or prove image coverage. PS1 mean/stack can repeat objects. Missing and -999 magnitudes are excluded from differences. PS1 colors use AB, WISE uses Vega; no extinction correction. Color errors assume independent measurements. PSF and Kron errors are correlated, so their quadrature is only a reference scale. Quality, blending and saturation flags remain in the raw rows. These data alone do not identify source nature.
